item.title: All Cheat Codes in GTA 6
item.description: The best part about any Grand Theft Auto game is the cheats , and Grand Theft Auto 6 delivers on that front. Rockstar's latest includes a whole mess of password-protected secrets that will really let you have some fun in Vice City. You'll have to work for them, though. GTA 6 's cheats are deeply hidden, and will require you to jump through a few hoops to start using them.

item.title: GTA 6 Cast List: Who plays Jason, Lucia and More
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has the longest story ever seen in a GTA game, which also means that it has an enormous cast of characters. Between rival faction leaders, radio station DJs, and fictional rappers, you're going to meet a whole lot of people in Leonida. And some of their voices might sound very familiar.

item.title: How Long Does It Take To Beat GTA 6?
item.description: If you couldn't guess by its 210 GB file size, Grand Theft Auto 6 is gigantic. Rockstar's latest open-world game is stuffed to the brim with things to do and steal. It also sports the beefiest story of any GTA game to date. Jason and Lucia star in a sprawling crime epic that takes the couple all around the state of Leonida. While it's difficult to put a consistent hour count on a true 100% playthrough of GTA 6 , we do know that you won't be able to binge it all in one long weekend.

item.title: 'Calvin and Hobbes' Best Miss Wormwood Quote Is Still Among the Smartest in Comic Strip History
item.description: Bill Watterson walked a few different tightropes when he created Calvin and Hobbes , one of which involved Calvin's relationship with school . It would've been easy to make it simply antagonistic, with Calvin as the hero fighting back against the dark forces of educational conformity, a bit like a comic adaptation of Pink Floyd's "Another Brick in the Wall." Any number of later webcomics that were unsubtly inspired by Calvin and Hobbes went this way, at least at first.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Cuts A Controversial Franchise Feature After 25 Years
item.description: You can do anything you want in a Grand Theft Auto game, but the franchise has historically been defined by a handful of specific mechanics. Steal a car. Shoot pedestrians. And for better or worse, soliciting a prostitute. Grand Theft Auto 6 , however, is an unusually realistic game that tells a humane story about a couple, and those shifts in approach are reflected in the game's actions.

item.title: The 10 greatest games to never get a GOTY nomination
item.description: The Game Awards announced its 2026 nominations yesterday, though not without controversy. Grand Theft Auto 6 — a game that isn't even out yet — leads the pack with eight nominations, including Game of the Year. No indies managed to get a GOTY nomination this year, despite the release of acclaimed games like Mina the Hollower and Big Walk. Several blockbusters — including Polygon favorites like Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave and Pokémon Pokopia — were also snubbed for the night's biggest award.

item.title: PlayStation Network Outage Hits On GTA 6 Release Day Eve
item.description: What happens when a potential 250 million people try logging into a server at the same time? Problems, that's what. Thursday, Nov. 19 is the official release day for Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, and it appears Sony's platform, commonly known as PlayStation Network, is already buckling the day before under enormous demand for the world's most hyped game.

item.title: 2026's Most Viral Movie with 97 Rotten Tomatoes Score Sets Streaming Date
item.description: In recent years, Nathan Fielder has rightfully earned a place as one of the most provocative figures in modern comedy. Most recently, the actor, filmmaker, and pilot (it’s a long story) co-directed You Can See Everything , a three-hour, brain-bending documentary about Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her partner Billy Evans in the days before Holmes began her 11-year prison sentence for defrauding investors.

item.title: GTA 6's Completely Unrealistic Mountains Had to Be in the Game, Rockstar Says
item.description: If you’ve ever spent time in and around Miami, Grand Theft Auto 6 is bound to delight you. Rockstar Games spared no expense in bringing the diverse world of Florida to life in digital form. Walk down the street in Vice City, and you’re sure to find an approximation of a bar you’ve actually been to . Head to the Leonida Keys, and you’ll find rows of houses on stilts. The attention to detail is impressive, but it also makes one odd detail about the map a little odd.

item.title: Switch 2 Is Getting an All-new Gamecube Controller
item.description: Super Smash Bros . fans, this one’s for you. Peripheral maker 8BitDo just revealed the GC Bluetooth Gamepad , a wireless spin on the GameCube controller meant for Nintendp Switch, Switch 2, and Windows PC. It’s available in the GameCube’s iconic purple-and-orange color palette and features the "classic GC design and iconic button layout," according to its product description. The controller can connect wirelessly via Bluetooth 5.0 or a 2.4 GHz adapter, and has wired support via a USB-C cable. All three connection types work with the original Switch and Switch 2, while only wired and 2.4 GHz wireless connections work on PC. The controller goes for $49.99 and ships on Dec. 10, 2026.
